name: The Rime Twin (station 5; PLAN.md section 6): Al-Qaran al-Saghir's glaciated summit caldera at 5,420 m (0.81 atm, EF, -18 C): an ice cap over the caldera floor under a basalt rim rising to 5,880 m, an active pit steaming through it with bare warm ground round it, Mount Erebus fumarolic ice towers 6-12 m on the fumaroles across the floor and up to the rim, steam caves melted into the ice margin and lit blue from within, boiling snow-slush cauldrons at the ice's foot, the upper mouth of tube 10 (tube_xanadu_se_10) melted into the glacier sole under the south-east wall; the NW Twin's plume 134 km off
